$comment: M2.2 / T-BR-01..05 — THE FROZEN WIRE SHAPE OF A CATALOGUED QUESTION.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS AT ALL. The catalogue crosses two services:
qe-explorer  app/inventory.form_signal_for(record)        (produces)
-> page_state.form_snapshot_signals[<question text>]
-> POST /internal/crawls/{id}/complete  coverage.states[].form_snapshot_signals
qe-central   app/services/catalog.extract_controls()      (consumes)
-> catalog.build_master_catalog() -> catalog_questions -> GET /apps/{id}/catalog
Neither service can test the other: both ship a top-level `app` package, so
one pytest process cannot import both. That is not a theoretical hazard here,
it is the history of this milestone. Every signal M2.2 restores was ALREADY
captured by the browser and ALREADY read by the catalogue — and died in the
one function between them that neither side's suite covered:
options_total   counted by inventory_js, read by catalog._options_total,
never emitted by form_signal_for. So a clipped 250-option
enumeration catalogued as complete, and the honesty marker
that exists at BOTH ends of the wire meant nothing.
locator         captured since M0.x, dropped at the same boundary. The
catalogue described a question in full and could not point
at the control that asks it.
validation      the same defect, fixed one milestone earlier — which is the
proof that this seam breaks silently and repeatedly.
Both suites were green through all of it, because a dropped field produces a
SMALLER true catalogue, never a failing one. Nothing errors; the deliverable
just knows less, and no test on either side can see the other end.
So the shape is frozen HERE, as data, and each side asserts against it in its
own process. Drop a key on either side and that side's own suite fails.
VALUE-FREE BY CONSTRUCTION. Every field below is SHAPE — what is asked, what
may be answered, what identifies the control. The sibling `form_snapshot`
(label -> committed value) deliberately does not cross this boundary. If a
future field could carry something a user typed, it does not belong here.
CHANGING THIS FILE IS A PROTOCOL CHANGE. Add the new version beside this one
rather than editing it in place, and ship the reader before the writer: the
consumer tolerates unknown keys, so a new field is invisible until it reads it.
$always: Emitted for EVERY value-bearing control. A button or link is not a question and gets no signal at all.
$conditional: Emitted only when the page declared it. ABSENCE IS EVIDENCE — it means the application said nothing, never that the crawl did not look.
$validation: The HTML constraint attributes the application declared about its own field. Mirrored in qe-explorer app/inventory._VALIDATION_KEYS and qe-central app/services/catalog._VALIDATION_KEYS — change both or neither.
$locator: The handle the PAGE declared for the control. `verified` is true only when the capture proved it resolves to exactly ONE control on the page it was seen on — a property of the page, which is why qe-explorer stamps it in build_inventory and not per control. `strategy` is empty and `verified` false when the application identifies the control by nothing usable; that is a finding about the application and is carried, not omitted.
$options_total: How many answers the control OFFERS in the page. Equals len(options) unless the read was clipped at the shared ceiling. NEVER less than len(options): a catalogue may not claim fewer answers than it holds.
$catalog_states: The honesty markers qe-central writes onto each question. Frozen here because a consumer that filters on them is depending on the exact strings.
